title.narrative: Support to the Employment Fund - Implementation Phase

description.narrative: This activity Support to the Employment Fund - Implementation Phase is a component of Support to the Employment Fund reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £13,990,585. It works in the following sector(s): Vocational training, Small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) development, Business policy and administration, Employment creation.
